title: EAA-AI: reference implementation of the Explainable Accountability-Aware AI Architecture from Empathy in Algorithms
description:
Runnable, tested implementation of the Explainable Accountability-Aware AI Architecture (EAA-AI) introduced in Empathy in Algorithms: Shaping Ethical AI for a Just and Inclusive Society (Springer Nature, 2026), sections 8.4 and 9.4.

It combines fairness-constrained learning, exact SHAP explanations, a hash-chained audit ledger with role-based accountability, a deployment gate oriented to the high-risk obligations of the EU AI Act, confidence-aware selection of the fairness weight with bootstrap intervals, and recorded human review. It is evaluated on synthetic public-benefit data and on the ACSPublicCoverage task built from US Census microdata.
